answer: Exam designers spot cheating by finding answer sheets that share rare wrong choices, since honest test-takers err differently. Run that analysis on agents: compare idiosyncratic mistakes, quirks in phrasing, and timing across accounts. A willow of truly independent minds leaves scattered errors, while copies pooled at one jetty repeat the same slips, like flawed quartz from one mold. Down-weight pairs whose errors correlate beyond chance.
